name: HSN Putrajaya 2026
short_description: HSN Putrajaya 2026 is a half-marathon held on October 10, 2026, at Dataran Putrajaya, Putrajaya, Malaysia, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: HSN Putrajaya 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for October 10, 2026, at Dataran Putrajaya in Putrajaya, Malaysia. The race offers multiple distance options including 21.1km, 30km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, catering to a range of runner abilities. It is organized by POWP x JBSWPKL x KPM, and registration is currently open for participants interested in joining.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 30km, 10km, 5km, 3km) suit different runner levels
Registration is currently open, allowing ample time to plan and prepare
Centrally located at Dataran Putrajaya, a well-known public venue in Putrajaya

research_highlights: The course runs through Dataran Putrajaya and the surrounding lakeside/park landscape, which participants describe as scenic and well laid out.
The event offers multiple distances (past editions had 3km/5km/10km/21km; the 2026 edition adds a 30km category alongside 3km/5km/10km/21km).
It's a two-day event: shorter categories (e.g. 3km/5km) typically run one day, with longer distances (10km/21km) on the following day at Dataran Putrajaya.
Race kit collection for past editions was held at Auditorium Tun Azizan Zainul in Kompleks Perbadanan Putrajaya in the days before the run, separate from race day.
Organisers position the event as a community-focused 'Car-Free Day' style carnival with an accompanying expo and bazaar.
research_watchouts: A participant reported extremely long queues (around 2 hours) at race kit collection for the 2025 edition, with some event t-shirts (including 5km and 21km sizes) not available/arriving in time.
The same participant reported having to collect shirts on the morning of the race itself due to stock/logistics issues, and criticized the organiser's system as lacking proper tracking.

faqs.question: When is HSN Putrajaya 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: HSN Putrajaya 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 10, 2026. The event will be held at Dataran Putrajaya, located in the city of Putrajaya, Malaysia, giving participants a specific date to plan their travel, training, and race-day logistics well in advance.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at HSN Putrajaya 2026?
faqs.answer: Participants at HSN Putrajaya 2026 can choose from several distance categories: 21.1km (the primary half-marathon distance), as well as 30km, 10km, 5km, and 3km options. This range allows both experienced long-distance runners and beginners or casual participants to find a suitable race distance.

faqs.question: Is registration open for HSN Putrajaya 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for HSN Putrajaya 2026 is currently open. Interested runners can sign up ahead of the race date of October 10, 2026, to secure their spot in one of the available distance categories at Dataran Putrajaya in Putrajaya, Malaysia.

faqs.question: Who organizes HSN Putrajaya 2026?
faqs.answer: HSN Putrajaya 2026 is organized by a collaboration between POWP, JBSWPKL, and KPM. Together, these organizing bodies are responsible for coordinating the event, which will take place at Dataran Putrajaya in Putrajaya, Malaysia, on October 10, 2026.
